question: What is the name of the 1, 3-isomer (or meta-isomer) of benzenediol with the chemical formula C₆H₄(OH)₂?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Resorcinol**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Resorcinol, also known as** m-dihydroxybenzene,** with the molecular formula C6H4(OH)2**.**
 
• It is an isomer of** benzenediol.**
 
• The name “**resorcinol**” is derived from the Latin word** “resina,” **which means** resin.**
 
• Resorcinol appears as **white to light pink crystals** or a powder. It is **odorless**. It is soluble in **water, alcohol, and ether.**
 
• Resorcinol is commonly used in topical medications for** treating skin conditions** such as** acne, psoriasis, and eczema.**
 
• It acts as a** keratolytic agent,** helping to remove** dead skin cells.**

**​ ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**m-Cresol:**

 
• m-Cresol is a **colorless liquid,** with the molecular formula **C₇H₈O.**
 
• It has a strong, **sweet odor.**
 
• It is used in the production of** resins, disinfectants, and synthetic fragrances.**

**Catechol:**

 
• Catechol is a** white crystalline solid**, with the molecular formula** C₆H₄(OH)₂**
 
• It is used in** photography**, as a reducing agent, and in the synthesis of pharmaceuticals.
 
• Catechol is the** 1,2-isomer of benzenediol.**

**​Glycerol:**

 
• Glycerol is a thick, **colorless liquid,** with the molecular formula **C₃H₈O₃**
 
• It is commonly used in **cosmetics, food, and pharmaceuticals**. It is a component of **fats and oils**.
